name: Deutschland

geography.notes: Use dated 8-digit AGS and retain 12-digit ARS as separately named identifiers. Preserve leading zeroes, Länder/Kreise and independent cities; postcodes are not municipality IDs. Add Ortsteile, industrial estates, rural eastern/western areas and North/Baltic islands as explicit locality aliases. FR/NL border vocabulary complements German; market country cannot be inferred from .de or language.

strategies.notes: This is a visible inaccessible registry route, not an executable census. The administrative base register is not public; statistical aggregates cannot supply dealer rows. Review lawful named-entity evidence through appropriate public surfaces separately without assuming exhaustive registry reuse.

Partition municipalities and Ortsteile, retaining rural and island strata. Consider licensed local OSM POIs as leads including Kfz-Werkstatt with sales, not a complete business census. Systematic public Nominatim enumeration is prohibited.

Traverse the federation-to-regional-innung structure with finite approved link boundaries. Regional member directories may reveal small independent garages. Each child domain and export needs admission; members are not all sellers.
Review the embedded member map's ownership and access before any collection. Include motorhome dealers, filter caravans/accessory-only shops, and retain independent nonmembers as an explicit gap.

Seed one official car network by municipality, then distinguish group, branch and owned inventory pages. This car surface does not establish LCV/motorcycle/camper coverage; add separately verified brand surfaces later.

Professional-account referrals across four classes; validate precise category routes when admitted. Preserve API cap/authentication debt, cross-border exporters and duplicates across accounts. Free browsing is not an API licence.
Long-tail professional claims may be sparse; keep private publisher accounts distinct. Retain tiny stock, and distinguish complete damaged vehicles from Ersatzteile or non-powered caravans.
Search local names and district aliases, including Kfz-Werkstätten, Gebrauchtwagenhandel and dismantlers only as whole-vehicle leads. Avoid minimum rating, employee or stock filters.

Find independent hosted inventories and inspect candidate-domain archive URLs only as historical leads. Common Crawl does not execute these full-text query templates. Do not require a .de domain or equate shared DMS with shared seller.
Manual public business referrals may reveal workshop sellers with a single vehicle. Login-only groups/pages and automation restrictions remain blocked, with explicit discovery debt.

sources.title: Destatis: Gemeindeverzeichnis GV-ISys
sources.access_notes: Official AGS/ARS geography with dated files and free individual queries. Contains municipal administration data, not all local businesses or Ortsteile.

sources.title: Destatis: Basisregister für Unternehmen FAQ
sources.access_notes: Explicitly not a public register; data are supplied only to legally entitled public bodies. Not a free dealer feed.

sources.title: Destatis: statistical business register
sources.access_notes: Statistical results provide contextual strata; do not treat published aggregate statistics as an accessible list of establishments.

sources.title: ZDK: Landesverbände and Innungen
sources.access_notes: Official association route to regional chambers/innungs websites. Membership, directory presence and stock are separate.

sources.title: DCHV: member map
sources.access_notes: Association's member map observed as embedded interactive surface. Underlying host requires its own admission; no member export assumed.

sources.title: Volkswagen Deutschland: Händlersuche
sources.access_notes: Official car locator; service and sales functions require evidence, and commercial-vehicle locators are distinct.

sources.title: mobile.de: public vehicle marketplace
sources.access_notes: Public portal observed; no contractual API access granted and professional account does not establish one legal entity/POS.

sources.title: mobile.de: Search API documentation
sources.access_notes: Published pagination and authentication/capability documentation is a research lead, not a free API licence. Keep inventory integration separate.

sources.title: Kleinanzeigen: public classifieds
sources.access_notes: Public category site observed. Mixed private/professional and parts/whole vehicles; no automated acquisition permission asserted.

sources.title: Gelbe Seiten: local business search
sources.access_notes: Directory observed; placements, stale records and workshops without sales bias results. Reuse permission not established.

sources.title: OpenStreetMap copyright and licence
sources.access_notes: ODbL and attribution obligations must be assessed before use of a dated local extract; no country completeness claim.

sources.title: OSMF public Nominatim usage policy
sources.access_notes: Public Nominatim forbids systematic locality/grid/all-POI queries. It is not an exhaustive discovery backend.

sources.title: Common Crawl URL index
sources.access_notes: Free URL archive index, not full-text search. Bound exact-domain lookups; bulk filtering belongs on local index data with resource budget. Archive results are historical leads.

sources.title: Meta explanation of automated collection restrictions
sources.access_notes: Prior permission is required for automated collection. This channel is manual public business-page lead review only, without account creation or login bypass.

blind_spots: The administrative Basisregister is inaccessible to general third parties; there is no validated free comprehensive dealer register in this profile.
GV-ISys lists municipalities and administration addresses, not every Ortsteil, estate or dealer. Island and sparse rural locality rows must be supplied and versioned.
Regional Innungen and DCHV omit nonmembers; OEM locators omit independents, other marques and service-only/retail differences.
Export dealers near NL/BE/FR/CH borders can publish in several markets; legal domicile, POS and vehicle location stay separate.
Online-only, social-only, immigrant-language and one-vehicle sellers remain eligible even without registry or association evidence.
Search result caps, archive age and portal syndication invalidate independence and exhaustive-coverage claims; unknown stock is never an exclusion rule.
